description: Production deploy, apply: runs the root-owned csa-prod-deploy entry script as the ubuntu user with the action fixed to apply. Published in AWS as csa-production-apply.

sha.description: Full 40 character lowercase commit sha on main, as the plan printed it.

migrations.description: Comma-separated four-digit migration numbers as the plan printed them, or empty.

hostDigest.description: 12 character lowercase hex host settings digest, as the plan printed it.

pythonDigest.description: Digest of the csa-python image to roll out, sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

frontendDigest.description: Digest of the csa-frontend image to roll out, sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

runCommand: exec runuser -u ubuntu -- /usr/local/sbin/csa-prod-deploy apply "{{ sha }}" "{{ migrations }}" "{{ hostDigest }}" "{{ pythonDigest }}" "{{ frontendDigest }}"
